Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.Enabled_tooltip: Master switch. When off, the home entry disappears and hired NPCs stop being paid or re-ordered (contracts stay in the save and come back if you re-enable it).
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.MaxContracts_to: How many NPCs one player may employ at the same time. Dead and dismissed NPCs do not count. Each employee is a full A-Life NPC and costs CPU plus A-Life population budget.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.SignPrice_toolt: Community currency charged to hire an A-Life NPC that is already in the world. The fee comes out of the Orange Community Economy balance; if you cannot pay, the hire fails and no contract is created.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.SpawnPrice_tool: Community currency charged to have A-Life spawn a brand new NPC for you. Pricier than hiring, but the NPC is guaranteed friendly. If A-Life hit its population ceiling the spawn fails and the fee is refunded in full.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.RecruitRadius_t: Only NPCs within this distance can be hired. The range is enforced server side (Jeem's own recruit has no distance check at all).
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.AllowHostile_to: When on, NPCs whose stance toward you is hostile also appear in the hire list. Off by default: paying someone who is shooting at you makes little sense.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.MakeAllied: Make the faction allied on hire
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.MakeAllied_tool: When on, signing the contract (right away, for every mode) pushes your Jeem standing with that NPC's faction/crew to the allied tier, and tops up the crew points too. That is what lets you convert the hire into a resident, AND what lets Jeem's own right-click 'invite the crew' succeed later - both check the same allied gate. Note that Jeem records standing per faction, so the whole faction becomes allied, not just this NPC.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.SpawnDistance_t: How far from you an agency-summoned NPC appears. Too close shoves you aside; 2-3 tiles is usually right.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.WageEnabled_too: When off, hiring is a one-off payment and employees never leave over unpaid wages.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.DailyWage_toolt: Every 24 in-game hours this is charged from your community currency balance for each employee. If you cannot pay, the contract goes into an unpaid state.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.UnpaidGraceDays: After this many in-game days of unpaid wages the employee leaves (residents are released back out of the Jeem resident system). 0 means they leave the moment a wage is missed.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.DefaultMode_too: The post selected when the panel opens. Follow = A-Life native follow order; Guard = hold a spot you choose; Resident = hand the NPC to the Jeem Extension resident system to guard your base (needs Jeem; residents do not follow you).
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.CreateCamp: Create a camp when you have none
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.CreateCamp_tool: Converting an employee into a Jeem resident needs a base. When on and you have no base, a small camp is created next to you with enough beds -- it takes one of Jeem's base slots. When off, having no base simply fails and the NPC falls back to Follow.
Sandbox_Bin2NPCExtension.DebugLog_toolti: Prints every step of the recruitment flow (picking a faction, spawning, assigning posts, re-issuing orders, wage settlement, fallbacks). Turn on while troubleshooting.
